content.title: Where to Watch ‘Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair,’ Sequel to the 2000s Sitcom
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News Where to Watch ‘Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair,’ Sequel to the 2000s Sitcom The Frankie Muniz-led four-part revival comes almost exactly 20 years after the 'Malcolm in the Middle' series finale. Courtesy of Hulu If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission. Frankie Muniz, Bryan Cranston, Jane Kaczmarek and Justin Berfield reunite after two decades for Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair, a four-episode revival of Linwood Boomer’s seven-season sitcom, which ran from 2000 to 2006. The 2026 limited series, also created by Boomer, drops in entirety on Friday, April 10, exclusively on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+, the latter being the most cost-effective streaming option (more on that below). At a Glance: How to Watch Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair Related Stories Premiere: Friday, April 10, 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET (full miniseries) No. of Episodes: 4 Stream online: Hulu; Hulu on Disney+; DirecTV signature packages (includes Hulu and Disney+ and offers a five-day free trial) For a cost comparison, both a Hulu and Disney+ subscription, on their own, start at $11.99 per month (or $23.98 monthly total), whereas the Hulu, Disney+ bundle starts at $12.99 per month. This means that for just $1 more, customers can get both services instead of one, a savings of 46 percent. For another way to bundle and save, DirecTV’s signature packages include Hulu, Disney+ and dozens of TV channels and DTV is currently offering a five-day free trial, meaning new subscribers can watch the entire miniseries (and everything else the streamer has to offer) at no cost. Following the trial period, packages start at $59.99 per month, on sale for a limited time. Where to Watch Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair Online: Best Hulu Streaming Deals 2026 Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair will stream exclusively on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. All four episodes in the miniseries drop on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET. The original series is also available to watch on-demand on Hulu/Disney+. For deal-savvy streamers, there are a number of ways to watch the show for free or at a discount. First, new subscribers can stream the reboot at no cost with a 30-day trial to Hulu’s ad-supported base plan, which regularly costs $11.99 per month. For the best bang for your buck, opt for the Hulu and Disney+ bundle, starting at $12.99 per month for the ad-supported base plan, just $1 more than each of the streaming services on their own. Disney+ Hulu Bundle $12.99/mo $23.98/mo 46% off Amounts to a savings of 46 percent compared to paying for each streaming service individually. Lastly, for those looking to broaden their streaming options, DirecTV’s signature packages (Entertainment, Choice, Ultimate and Premier) also include both Hulu and Disney+, and offer a five-day free trial. DirecTV Learn more about each plan option, including how to build your own channel lineup from $19.99, at directv.com.
